work.description: The act canonizes Peter Baptist and his Franciscan companions, martyrs of Japan, with the full subscriptions of the cardinals. Issuer evidence: PIVS EPISCOPVS BERVUS SERVORUM DEI at LF17933-17936. Dating LF18979-18981 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctuui Petrum Anno In- carnationis Dominicae MDCCCLXH, VI Idus Julias Pontificatus Nostri Anno XVII. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
